landing.heroDescription: NeoCAST supports various input tools including Neo Smartpen, stylus, touch, and mouse. A real-time collaboration platform where you can freely write, draw, and communicate anytime, anywhere.
landing.section1Description: Teachers (hosts) can monitor all students' (guests') handwriting at a glance and provide individual feedback. Connect as vividly as if you were in the classroom, regardless of physical distance.
landing.section2Description: Write on paper with Neo Smartpen and see it appear on screen instantly. Mouse and touch input are also fully supported. Use your most comfortable tool to unleash creativity.
landing.section3Description: Record and replay not just the final result, but the entire thought process. Share and deeply analyze problem-solving steps or design sketch flows.
landing.section4Description: Invite participants easily with just one link, like Zoom, Teams, or Meet. Join sessions instantly by clicking the link, without complex installation or registration.
landing.section5Description: Your valuable ideas and data are protected safely. Manage session access with strong security technology and keep your personal information safe.

newConcept.subtitle: smart classroom with Ncode
newConcept.description: Transform ordinary PDFs into smart Ncode textbooks using NeoLAB's exclusive patented technology. Easily distribute your custom materials to students and share handwriting in real-time.

educator.title: Smart Education Expert
educator.description: Teachers who want to closely monitor students' problem-solving processes and provide personalized feedback

tutor.title: Remote Tutoring Coach
tutor.description: Real-time annotation guidance for student problem-solving that's hard to verify through video conferencing alone

consultant.title: Business Consultant
consultant.description: Explain complex ideas by drawing on paper and professionally deliver the process and voice

counselor.title: Child Development Counseling Center
counselor.description: AI-powered precise analysis of drawing test sequences, pen pressure, etc. for counseling support materials

ncode.title: Ncode Technology
ncode.description: Microscopic patterns printed on paper, nearly invisible to the eye, but the core technology that enables smartpens to accurately recognize position, pen pressure, and time information.

smartpen.title: Smartpen Technology
smartpen.description: Provides the same writing feel as a regular pen, with built-in high-speed camera and processor tracking coordinates up to 240 times per second and transmitting data.

paperhub.title: PaperHub Technology
paperhub.description: Safely stores and manages all data generated on physical paper in digital space, allowing access and search anytime, anywhere.

pod.title: Print On Demand
pod.description: An eco-friendly solution where anyone with a regular laser printer can print and use Ncode-embedded textbooks or forms without a dedicated factory.

footer.description: Since our founding in 2009, we have been researching technology that breaks down the boundaries between paper and digital. NeoLAB boasts the world's No.1 market share and technology in smartpen and Ncode technology.

newLanding.heroDesc1: Even from a distance, pen strokes on paper sync in real time.
newLanding.heroDesc2: Zero-latency handwriting sharing — made possible with NeoCAST.
newLanding.cycleTitle: A Learning Cycle That Turns Thinking Into Data
newLanding.step1Desc: Analyze previous learning records to identify student weaknesses in advance and design lesson difficulty and direction.
newLanding.step2Desc: Monitor students' writing process in real time, online or offline. See their thinking through the movement of the pen.
newLanding.step3Desc: Go beyond right or wrong answers — analyze pen pauses and trajectories to pinpoint exactly where students struggle.
newLanding.step4Desc: All records are automatically saved and turned into growth reports. Use them for review materials and track student progress with data.
newLanding.coreValueTitle: All You Need Is Paper and a Pen
newLanding.coreValueDesc: No expensive equipment or special classroom setup required. Connect the focus of familiar paper to the digital world.
newLanding.val1Desc: Simply write on paper with a smartpen
newLanding.val2Desc: Monitor all students' learning progress at a glance
newLanding.val3Desc: All handwriting is auto-saved for review anytime
newLanding.val4Desc: Instantly share additional materials with students
newLanding.val5Desc: Access via a single URL — no downloads needed
newLanding.val6Desc: Provide real-time guidance to students via voice chat
newLanding.ctaBottomDesc: Discover the clues to growth hidden in handwriting with NeoCAST.
